column6: {X Y : TopCat} → {A : Set ↑X} → {B : Set ↑Y} → (f : X ⟶ Y) → (∀ a ∈ A, (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f) a ∈ B) → (TopPair.ofSubset A ⟶ TopPair.ofSubset B)

∀ {X Y : TopCat} {A : Set ↑X} {B : Set ↑Y} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : ∀ a ∈ A, (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f) a ∈ B) (x : ↑X), (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (TopPair.Hom.fst (OAI.Topology.Category.TopPairOf.TopPair.ofSubsetHom f hf))) x = (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f) x

∀ {X Y : TopCat} {A : Set ↑X} {B : Set ↑Y} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : ∀ a ∈ A, (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f) a ∈ B) (a : ↑A), ↑((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (TopPair.Hom.snd (OAI.Topology.Category.TopPairOf.TopPair.ofSubsetHom f hf))) a) = (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f) ↑a
